verdict.rationale: Foreloop is presented as a hosted SaaS orchestration service (with an approvals list, MCP endpoint, GitHub integration) rather than software distributed for self-hosting; no evidence pack item mentions a self-hostable server, Docker image, or on-prem deployment option, and the product's architecture (cloud dashboard, phone approvals, hosted MCP endpoint) implies it is inherently hosted by the vendor. This makes self-hosting a category mismatch rather than a missing feature.
